name: Sorrel
title: Drover
examine: First thing she did out of the Ring was gentle a spooked cow, and she took that as instruction. Half her words go to the animal, and the animal answers.
lines: Steady. That one is only looking at you.
Water first, then hay. You know the order, don't you. Yes you do.
The Ring gave me a cow to calm before it gave me a name. I've trusted it since.
